44001.story: As of Oct 16, the census value of land and buildings in Bristol County was $49,530 an acre in 2022. That is up 9.9% from $45,085 in 2017, or 1.9% a year. Back in 2012 the census value sat at $25,567 an acre. In 2022, 41% of the farmland here was rented.

44005.story: As of Oct 16, the census value of land and buildings in Newport County was $35,737 an acre in 2022. That is up 46.4% from $24,407 in 2017, which works out to 7.9% a year. Back in 2012 the figure was $22,248, so the bigger jump came in the later stretch. In 2022, 33% of the county's farmland was rented.

44009.story: As of Oct 16, the census value of land and buildings in Washington County was $24,586 an acre in 2022. That is up 80.7% from $13,608 in 2017, which works out to 12.6% a year. Back in 2012 the figure stood at $11,870. In 2022, 22% of the county's farmland was rented.
